description: News search API for AI agents: Google News results as JSON for a topic, company or person. Returns article titles, sources, timestamps, URLs and snippets when available for news monitoring and research, with country and language targeting. Price: 5 prepaid credits per successful call. MCP returns a compact view of these results.

country.description: Two-letter country code used to localize news results.

language.description: Two-letter language code for news result text.

results.description: Maximum number of news articles to return.

name: search_news
title: Search News
